title: Bullet Hit FX
description: Peter-approved bullet hits (2026-10-15). Feel-booth preview only — not wired into live combat. fx-hit-fire and fx-hit-water are 4×24 @ 8 fps (0.5s), once, origin (0.5, 0.5) at the impact point. The burst is drawn left → right on the sheet (bullets travel left; the spray faces travel). Feel-booth playback uses the sheet as drawn. Water uses the fx-water-proj cyan palette. Fire uses the flame orange/yellow palette. Display size is the authored 24px frame at scale 1. Blend ADD or NORMAL; the feel booth uses ADD. Feel-booth key 8 is fire and key 9 is water. fx-hit-electric is not in this wave.
